content.title: News Flash
content.summary: The City of Arvada has declared a Stage 1 drought, implementing water restrictions effective April 15, 2026, aimed at reducing water use by at least 20%. Additionally, the city is hosting various events, including a professional fireworks display on July 4, 2026, and a Pollinator Garden Tour featuring local gardens, with registration required for participation.

## [Stage 1 Drought Water Restrictions](/m/newsflash/Home/Detail/328)

The City has declared a drought and Stage 1 water restrictions are in effect beginning April 15, 2026. Stage 1 drought conditions mean water supply is low and mandatory restrictions are in place. The goal is to reduce water use by at least 20%. Visit the water restrictions webpage for more information.

Home

  ### [Join us for the 2026 Pollinator Garden Tour!](/m/newsflash/Home/Detail/246)

  Join us for the annual Pollinator Garden Tour featuring 8 inspiring home gardens across Arvada, showcasing native plants, water-wise landscaping and habitat-friendly design for pollinators.

  You can tour the gardens in any order and visit as many—or as few—as you like. Plan about 20 minutes per stop if you’d like to see all nine gardens. The tour concludes at Majestic View Nature Center, where participants who **visit all gardens can collect a special prize.**

  Registration is required in order to receive garden addresses.

  Please bring comfortable walking shoes, water and sun protection.

  [Register Here](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog?filter=c2VhcmNoPTQzNTQ3Njc=)
